This application coming on for admission this day, the

 Order

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.712/2022 registered at Police Station-Gorakhpur District-Jabalpur (MP) for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 120-B & 34 of IPC.

Earlier bail application M.Cr.c.No.4663/2023 was dismissed as withdrawn on 13.02.2023.
2.
As per prosecution story, one Preeti Bajpai gave a written complaint to Superintendent of Police Jabalpur.
Sudhakar Rao and his two sons Abhijeet Sudhakar Udawant & Anant Sudhakar Udawant came to her house in 2019 and represented to complainant for investing money for purchase of 5 hectares of land.
They showed documents; power of attorney of owners, made proposal for development of said land.
Complainant believed representation of accused and gave them an amount of Rs.28,25,000/-.
They showed her an agreement which was not signed by complainant and her daughter.
It appeared to complainant that same was forged.

Accused persons did not Sudhakar Raw Udavant vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193960379/
1 execute registered sale-deed.

sentences.text: Later on complainant learnt that holder of power of attorney were not the owners of land in question.
Applicants had committed cheating and forgery with complainant.
Over said complaint, offence under Section 420, 467 of IPC was registered against applicant and other co-accused persons.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 09.01.2023.
It is submitted that it is civil dispute between parties, therefore, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.
Prima-facie, offence under Section 420, 467 r/w 120-B of IPC is made out against applicant.
Offence under Section 467 of IPC is punishable for imprisonment for life or upto 10 years and fine.

Offence committed by applicant is serious in nature.
6. Considering aforesaid circumstances of the case, bail application filed by applicant is dismissed.
